S3.description: Supplementary Table S3: SMR of UKB-PPP plasma cis-pQTL (b_eQTL header kept for pQTL effects) on FinnGen R10 N14_ENDOMETRIOSIS; one top cis-pQTL per protein, b_eQTL and b_GWAS both on A1. The same SNPs with identical exposure beta/se are the MR instruments in Supplementary Table S1 (F-values of all IVs), whose Wald ratios are in Table S2.

Tao2024-1.notes: Single cis-pQTL rs314361 (same SNP/beta as Table S1 IV); Table S2 Wald ratio beta 0.3349.

Tao2024-2.notes: Single cis-pQTL rs11031006 (same SNP/beta as Table S1 IV); Table S2 Wald ratio beta 1.3623.

Tao2024-3.notes: Single cis-pQTL rs1936800 (same SNP/beta as Table S1 IV); Table S2 Wald ratio beta 0.4705.

Tao2024-4.notes: Single cis-pQTL rs113443718 (same SNP/beta as Table S1 IV); Table S2 Wald ratio beta 0.3613.

Tao2024-5.notes: Single cis-pQTL rs10860846 (same SNP/beta as Table S1 IV); Table S2 Wald ratio beta 0.6919 (claim n_instruments not stated).

Tao2024-6.notes: Single cis-pQTL rs1870377 (same SNP/beta as Table S1 IV); Table S2 Wald ratio beta -0.1969 (OR 0.821). The claim's OR 0.8 is the text value rounded to one decimal, so the recompute check against log(0.8) may fall just outside tolerance.
